title: There is / there are: free practice
titleEs: There is / there are: práctica libre
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: There ___ a problem with my phone.
There ___ some apples on the table.

items.source: There is a cat in the garden.
answers: There isn't a cat in the garden.
There's no cat in the garden.
There is no cat in the garden.
There's not a cat in the garden.
items.explanationEs: Negativa: there isn't a… o there is no…

items.source: There are some chairs in the room.
answers: Are there any chairs in the room?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta: are antes de there, y some pasa a any.

items.sentence: There is two banks on my street.
items.explanationEs: Two banks es plural: there are.
